items.statement: Every trade in the input set appears in exactly one of: the matched set, or the exceptions set — never both, and never dropped silently.
items.enforcementPoint: TradeReconciliationEngine's classification loop; enforced by a unit test asserting matched.Count + exceptions.Count == inputTrades.Count for every fixture.

items.statement: A settlement record is never matched to more than one trade.
items.enforcementPoint: TradeReconciliationEngine's matching index, which removes a settlement record from the candidate pool once consumed by a match.

items.statement: The tolerance comparison is a closed interval: an amount difference exactly equal to the configured tolerance is a MATCH, not AMOUNT_MISMATCH.
items.enforcementPoint: TradeReconciliationEngine.IsWithinTolerance, covered by a boundary-value unit test at exactly the tolerance value.

items.statement: Monetary values written to output files never lose precision relative to the decimal values read from input (no float/double coercion anywhere in the pipeline).
items.enforcementPoint: All trade/settlement amount fields are typed as System.Decimal end-to-end; enforced by static analysis rule banning double/float on amount-named fields in the reconciliation namespace.
